operating_rules: CURRENT contains exactly one product train.
NEXT is ordered and contains only work with a concrete player outcome and acceptance contract.
FUTURE preserves sequenced product families without pretending they are active.
PARKED contains separated or dependency-blocked work and states the release condition.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof, not a planning claim.
The board does not create sub-beads, meta-audits, or a replacement House hierarchy.

current.title: Zork Plus: Veteran Survey Expedition
current.outcome: Turn a genuinely sealed canonical victory into one explicitly selected, physically prepared postgame survey with its own objective, custody outcome, and separate Expedition Box B history.
scope: physical veteran dispatch in sealed Expedition Box A
exact one-item brass-lantern or rope loadout
physical Attic hold trunk for every other directly carried object
lantern and rope round-trip survey-cut routes
boundary-marker recording on a physical field card
separate Expedition Box B completion with retained-or-left-behind custody
dependencies: completed expedition archive with separate boxes A and B
acceptance: production staging changes exactly completed_expedition_archive.zil, zork1.zil, and zork_plus_veteran_expedition.zil
Veteran Expedition remains unavailable before Expedition A is genuinely sealed
the player explicitly chooses only the canonical brass lantern or canonical rope
every unselected directly carried object moves into the physical Attic hold trunk
the production artifact contains no test setup verbs
a separate test-only precondition build seeds sealed Expedition A and then uses only real player commands
both lantern and rope routes complete round trips in Glulxe
the boundary marker is recorded rather than removed or duplicated
Expedition Box B seals separately and records retained-versus-left-behind item custody
the first green production artifact is locked and reproduced before squash merge
boundaries: no generic New Game Plus framework or restart menu
no silent change to the canonical first expedition
no TAKE EVERYTHING loadout or universal equipment slots
no duplicate lantern, rope, treasure, or canonical puzzle object
no merged Expedition A and B histories
no House hierarchy reopening or S.T.A.L.K.E.R. mixing
